## findings (frozen, pre-reveal)

1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED** — undeclared override (F-1). Symptom: two clauses govern whether entitlement on this foreclosed loan can be restored while its guaranty debt has a balance. Root cause: loan_agg_entitlement sentence "entitlement lost on a foreclosed loan stays in use until the resulting debt is repaid" not named in loan_ext_liquidated_loan_restoration.overwrite. Evidence: `loan.extended.yaml` policies[loan_agg_entitlement].rule vs extended_policies[loan_ext_liquidated_loan_restoration].overwrite / rule; debt `08a499aa…` balance 14497.23. Consequence: base reading → nothing restored today; extended reading → 56416.58. Affected: extended charter overwrite of loan_ext_liquidated_loan_restoration; root write.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED** — refund computation's factors (F-5, F-6). Symptom: 811.84 of the derived refund comes from a lender late charge returned at 2× and from interest on a refund. Root cause: ladders whose non-fall-through tiers are treatments VA does not give (late charge is the lender's; no interest on refunds), and a clock whose conjunct holds of every refund write. Consequence: after striking, the refund computation has 1 factor (< 4; < 2 parameter). Affected: loan_ext_exempt_fee_refund.factors / rule; write 1 amount.
3. Observation — restoration tool hard-codes basis `debt_repaid_after_claim` although the debt is not repaid (O-5).
